theorems.name: Submission.rsod_ae_tendsto_density_zero_outside
theorems.statement: ∀ (n ℓ : ℕ) (ν : Measure (Amb n ℓ)) (A : Set (Amb n ℓ)), MeasurableSet A → ν A < ∞ → ∀ᵐ x ∂(μHE[n] : Measure (Amb n ℓ)), x ∉ A → Tendsto (fun ρ : ℝ => (ρ ^ n)⁻¹ * ν.real (A ∩ closedBall x ρ)) (𝓝[>] 0) (𝓝 0)
